steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Ouch, this hurts! Really! I thought the FAC was known for being polite and gentle? Why are you being so rough with me?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: I'm your colleague's widow. Can't you be a bit nicer to me?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Ha, what an amateur. Not only full of lies, but full of nonsense, too.
With a thrust of her shield, she throws a round table at the shopkeeper. The woman dodges it and pulls out a few arrows to fight back, and the two back away from each other.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: I'm telling the truth. I was married to a loving husband and now he is dead. These are my real life experiences.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You used him to collect intelligence on the FAC, and then you killed him?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: No. He was a great man, upright and doting. He respected my privacy and never pried into my <color=#fb9259>secrets</color>.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: If he had listened to me and didn't take on the West District mission... Maybe I would have truly fallen in love with him as time went on.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Too bad that good men always want to be heroes and clean up other people's messes. He went out over and over again, so he was destined to not come back one day... You also work for the FAC. Surely you understand?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: A new Black Ring appeared in Syndicate. How many of your teammates died there? I know this is your glorious tradition—the FAC loves meaningless sacrifices.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: So, I didn't kill him. Instead, we're in the same boat, and should chat more about it... Ah!
She dodges a second attack as she yelp. It was a close call, but a missed one nonetheless. Rahu feels that her movements have slowed down, and that her body is spinning out of control.
She immediately realizes what happened.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You used neurotoxins on me?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Smart girl. I know your combat habits. You love to fight your opponents head-on without any hesitation, and always put your life on the line to shield others. This is the best way to deal with you.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Oh, stop thrashing around. This poison contains a hint of Mania. If you have Hypercubes on you, just wait quietly for it to be purified. I don't want to hurt you just yet.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Let's have a chat.
The assassin doesn't make any further moves. On the contrary, the frivolous smile on her face fades away.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: In the past four months, all the Black Rings across the city-state have become active. The bulk of FAC forces have gone to deal with them. You have no resources to deal with incidents in Eastside right now. Such matters have already been delegated to the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Rahu, no, Sinner of the <color=#fb9259>FAC-G47</color> squadron, you shouldn't even be here. Your superiors haven't issued any assistance orders at all.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: You returned to Eastside on your own and forcibly intervened in a case that has nothing to do with you. You kept all the clues you found for yourself and even came to see me, the assassin, alone... I bet even your Sinner power didn't come clean, did it?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: As an FAC soldier, obedience and loyalty are your sworn duties, but you have stepped on so many red lines. Any one of them is enough to send you to be court martialed.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Ha, you found out a lot in just a few hours.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Are you threatening me?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: ...No, I understand you. More than you know.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: You're the only survivor of the <color=#fb9259>Eclipse Operation</color> to DisSea. You're here for revenge.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: In <color=#fb9259>N.F. 103</color>, the FAC received an emergency order and deployed 28 squadrons to secretly go to DisSea to break into BR-000. With little time and information, the mission reaped no results, and only you survived.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: It was an absurd mission. But afterwards, the commander who devised the tactics went into hiding, and the FAC got scapegoated for all the losses.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Did you also get this information from your "dead husbands"?

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: No, they wouldn't know. Anyone who knows this won't be able to sit there and do nothing. Like you and I.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: My father was a transport worker in the FAC's logistics department. In N.F. 103, he was at the base and got infected by materials secretly recovered from the Eclipse Operation. He died before even knowing what it was.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: My father got infected with Mania. Amidst the chaos, he went home without going through the necessary checks, and turned into a Corruptor right in front of my siblings...

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Like you, I was the lone survivor that night. I understand your hate.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: All these years, you sacrificed so much to become a Sinner, suppressing all your hatred to be a dog for Paradeisos, yet you still can't get a grasp of the conspiracy.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: I know the cold, dark path under your feet. I've traveled along that same path.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Our lives were completely destroyed in an instant. Nobody gave us justice, so we can only seek justice ourselves. There must be some fairness in this world, right?
She hands Rahu a purple carnation.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: My name is <color=#fb9259>Garofano</color>. I'm not your enemy. We are the <color=#fb9259>same kind</color>, and there are many more of us out there.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: There is a place in this world that accepts us, and someone there who understands us. <color=#fb9259>She</color> will guide and support you in exacting cold, sweet revenge.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: If it's what you desire, I can take you to her.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Are you talking about your patron, or the leader of your organization?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: It's the new <color=#fb9259>family</color> I tried so hard to find.
She answers sincerely, and the emotion in her voice seems to move Rahu. The FAC soldier remains silent for a while.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You say she'll help you seek revenge...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Then the Mania you released and the Corruptor monsters you brought... She was behind all that? She gave you those to seek revenge?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The woman you're trying to kill and the people around her... what crimes have they committed? Why are you treating them like this?
The assassin detects Rahu's hostility. A trace of disappointment flashes in her eyes. She feels up a few needles as she calculates the duration of the toxin and tries to make a final argument.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: She's from Paradeisos, Rahu. No one from Paradeisos is innocent. They are all enemies. The most powerful and terrible enemies.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You hate her too, don't you?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Just like you risked your life to become a Sinner, I must gain the strength to fight them. We all have to fight for what we want, and we all have to give up some things.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Revenge is about giving your all. You know that best, don't you? Now is your chance. We can help you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...If you're telling the truth, then I get it.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: There's no such thing as "we". Don't kid yourself, and don't confuse us as the same kind.
She throws the Hypercube on her body aside and smashes her shields, triggering the violent Mania in her body to neutralize the neurotoxins.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm an FAC soldier. I will protect my comrades-in-arms, the front line, and all those who must be protected in DisCity. I will give my all to fight against the villains who harm them.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I will rebuild all the ruined morals the FAC way. Even if I'm the only one on that dark and lonesome path, I'll keep going till I die. That is my <color=#fb9259>revenge</color>.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Yet you...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Doing the bidding of shady gutter rats, abusing Mania to kill innocents, and using revenge as an excuse to do evil. We've never been the same kind. You're but a useful idiot exploited by others.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You, your organization, and the scumbags behind you... shall always be the FAC's enemies!

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...What a pity. I really wanted to take you home.
